name: Mimi tomo
description: The word from the merchant trail is that a certain "Unusual Hilichurl" has been gathering its fellow 'churls out in the wild recently... If you want to catch this most mysterious creature, you may find that the best strategy is to ingratiate yourself with some hilichurls and enlist their help...
